div.head: Ine 18
div.ab: Ciorlisc mon gif he oft betogen wære, gif he æt siðestan sí gefongen, slea mon hond of oððe fot.
LXII. Cierlisc mon gif he óft betygen wære, gif he æt siðestan sie gefongen, slea mon hond oððe fot.
Cyrliscus homo, qui sepe fuerit accusatus de furto et deinceps inuenietur reus in captali uel in alia manifesta culpa, truncetur ei manus uel pes.
{LXII} Cierlisc mon gif he óft betygen wære: gif he æt siðestan sie gefongen, slea mon hond [of] oððe fot.
A man of ceorl rank who has often been accused: if he is finally caught [in the act], let his hand or foot be struck off.
If a commoner, who has often been accused, is at last caught [in the act], his hand or foot shall be cut off.
If a ceorl is often accused, and if at the last he is taken [in the act], his hand or foot is to be struck off.
Ein gemeinfreier Mensch, wenn er [schon früher] oft bezichtigt gewesen ist, wenn der zuletzt [handhaft] gefangen wird, so schlage man [ihm] Hand oder Fuss (ab).
A common freeman, if he has [already] often been accused, if he is at last caught [red-handed], let his hand or foot be struck (off).
